text: Added cross-platform surface-view module and build aggregates/aliases. Implemented smart scalar/id/camera/light types, closed layer family for scalar/label/mask/packed RGBA data, exact-domain model validation, static/dynamic frame compatibility, immutable viewer state and total action reducer, explicit bilateral layouts, and a backend-free compiler emitting world-space primitive buffer views, stable mesh/layer keys, camera matrices, draw passes, graphics Scene chrome, readouts, profiles, and deterministic receipts. surfaceViewJVM/test and surfaceViewJS/test both pass 8/8.
